payload_json.lineage: Part 2 asks about one journey the candidate repeats every week and how they feel about repeating it; Part 3 widens to what regular travel does to people and where they choose to live (M5, M1, M7), then to who should pay for transport and whether people will travel less (M6, M9, M2).
